# `openjd diff` examples

<!-- Generated by crates/openjd-cli/tests/diff_examples.rs. Do not edit; run
     UPDATE_DIFF_EXAMPLES=1 cargo test -p openjd-cli --test diff_examples -->

**Unstable.** `openjd diff` may change its flags and output in any release. Every command
also prints `warning: 'openjd diff' is unstable; its flags and output may change.` to stderr, which is left out here.

One case per field the diff can report ([diff.md](diff.md),
[model/template-diff.md](../model/template-diff.md)). Commands run from the repository
root, on the templates in `crates/openjd-cli/examples/diff/` and
`crates/openjd-model/examples/template_diff/`. The output below is the real output of
each command, checked by a test.

## Coverage

`shown as` is the main output line. A line printed under a step header is relative to the
step, so here it carries the change's full path, as a change prints on its own
(`~ steps[Render].description: …`). `origin` and `stage` are the values over the case's
changes, and `plan kinds` the mutation kinds of `--plan`.

Not shown:

| field | why |
|---|---|
| `specificationVersion` | `jobtemplate-2023-09` is the only job template version, so it cannot change. |
| parameter, environment or embedded file `name` | Entries are matched by name, so a rename is a remove and an add, as `step_renamed` shows. |
| `<collection>.duplicates` | Template validation rejects repeated names; only a hand-edited built job has them, and `--plan` rejects them. |
| an empty list versus none, other than `hostRequirements.amounts` and `attributes` | Template validation rejects an empty `parameterDefinitions`, `jobEnvironments`, `stepEnvironments`, `dependencies`, `taskParameterDefinitions`, `embeddedFiles` or `args`, so only a hand-edited built job has one. An empty `amounts` or `attributes` is accepted beside the other, as `host_amounts_empty` shows. |
| embedded file `type` | `TEXT` is the only embedded file type, so it cannot change. |
| embedded file `endOfLine`; other actions (`onExit`, `onWrap*`) | Shown like the fields above: one line per field, under the same path. |

## Job

### job_name

The job is renamed.

```console
$ openjd diff crates/openjd-cli/examples/diff/job_name_v1.yaml crates/openjd-cli/examples/diff/job_name_v2.yaml
crates/openjd-cli/examples/diff/job_name_v1.yaml -> crates/openjd-cli/examples/diff/job_name_v2.yaml
~ name: Demo -> Demo v2  [template]

0 steps changed. Tasks: 1 kept, 0 added, 0 removed.
```
